content.text:
I checked the letter for the year-to-date figure.

**Finding:** The letter reports Q2 net (-3.36%), Q2 gross (-3.16%), and the index (-2.95%), but the performance paragraph stops there. There is no year-to-date figure anywhere in the letter — no "0.92%", no "year to date," and no equivalent phrasing such as "so far this year" or "since January." The trailing 12-month figure is likewise absent, but that point was not in scope.

Because the omission is total rather than a misstatement, this is **not conveyed** rather than distorted. Worth flagging to the drafter: the YTD figure is the only positive performance number available for the period and its absence leaves the letter reading more negatively than the fact sheet supports — a notable issue given the tone note about Samuel's skepticism.

points.evidence: The letter's performance discussion covers only the quarter: "your portfolio returned -3.36% net of fees... the gross-of-fees return was -3.16%, while the comparison index for Developed Markets Core Equity (unscreened) declined by -2.95%." No year-to-date return is stated anywhere in the letter; the figure 0.92% and any equivalent phrasing ("year to date," "so far this year") do not appear.
